messages:
maya: Heads-up — DAST runs on staging started failing after last night's RBAC/keystore change. Getting 403 on artifact decrypt when scanner fetches session recordings. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

sast-bot: automatic-alert: pipeline=staging-dast job=fetch-artifacts status=FAILED details=
```
ERROR: artifact fetch failed
cause: kms.DecryptAccessDenied: Access denied for serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
stack: fetcher.go:87
```

owen: I saw a couple CI failures earlier. Sounds like the scanner service account lost kms:decrypt or the SA-to-role binding was removed during the keystore RBAC tidy. Can you paste the exact error snippet / SA name?

maya: Error above is full. SA is scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. We rolled the keystore policy last night — likely culprit.

sam: Oncall here — I can regrant temporarily. Do we want a quick grant or revert the change? Also need an audit log entry for compliance. :eyes:

jen: Quick plan: 1) grant scanner-sa kms.decrypt for the key used by staging, 2) rerun the DAST job, 3) collect KMS audit log entries and attach to the vuln ticket if green. I'll file the ticket for the permanent playbook.

owen: Agreed. Long-term we should avoid directly granting kms access — prefer ephemeral signed URLs or a scanner proxy that decrypts in a bounded environment. But for recovery, temp grant is fine.

sam: Giving scanner-sa kms.decrypt for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/dast-key — granting for 1 hour. Doing it now.

sam: Command I ran (audit):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding dast-key \
  --location global --keyring staging \
  --member serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

maya: Rerunning the staging DAST job now.

sast-bot: rerun queued: job=staging-dast id=ci-2024-07-18-4521

sast-bot: run-complete: job=staging-dast status=SUCCESS duration=3m12s

maya: Scan succeeded after the temporary grant. Attaching last KMS audit entries to the ticket.

jen: For the ticket: include the KMS audit log entry (principal: sam@redwood), the RBAC change PR id, and the timestamps. Also note that SAST runs weren't affected — only DAST fetch flow uses KMS for ephemeral artifact decrypt.

owen: Action items: - maya to open a PR to update the runbook with a preflight that tests KMS decrypt for scanner SA - infra to evaluate scanner proxy/signed-url fallback - security to add an approval gate for keystore RBAC changes when scanners are in flight

maya: I'll open the PR to the runbook and include the preflight command:
```
kubectl run --rm -i --restart=Never decrypt-test --image=gcr.io/redwood-tools/kms-check \
  --command -- /bin/check-decrypt --sa=scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/dast-key
```

sam: Filing the short incident note and marking as resolved after PR + audit attach. :thumbsup:

jen: Also add a small note to the compliance folder about temporary grants being logged and short-lived (<=1h). We'll refine into a formal SOP.

owen: I'll sketch the proxy design this week. Suggest we also add an alert when a keystore role-binding is removed for any service account in the scanner namespace.

maya: Thanks everyone — reopening if it flaps. For now I'll close the ticket once PR and audit are attached.

oncall: noted. closing thread in 24h if no further errors.
